translations.web: I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the kings like you for all your days.
translations.bsb: Moreover, I will give you what you did not request—both riches and honor—so that during all your days no man in any kingdom will be your equal.
translations.kjv: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.
translations.asv: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches and honor, so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee, all thy days.
